title: Diseño de Pantalla de Equipamiento: Guerrero Cyberpunk con Desglose Detallado de Equipo
prompt: Make the layout resemble an equipment screen in a game. Divide the image into two sections: on the left, display the character, a cyberpunk warrior in futuristic armor. On the right, place every piece of clothing and equipment the character is wearing into separate grid slots, each with a label and a short description of its function below it.
